In order to avoid being cut off from the magma entirely and die off due to this, they will have long roots that will penetrate through the cave walls allowing them to transfer the needed heat and resources to their colonies. What are a few ways you can maintain access to the Internet while still living off the grid? I like the idea of having a large degree of independence, and producing a majority of my own resources. I'd like to know the most "off the grid" methods of Internet access.
I'm pretty interested in living off the grid, but it's tough to figure Internet into it.
Oh boy, I can say for sure on that. I grew up in rural Oregon, and my mom still lives out there. She can barely check her email, and pays $90 a month for the privilege.

Depending on where you live you may have some options.

One would be is if there's a point to point WiFi type provider in your area. Basically they would supply you with a WiFi antenna what you would point to their tower and you could run your own cat5 or cat6 to your house/cabin. Price will vary.

The other option is to get a 4g cell router. These can have built in WiFi but also come with an Ethernet port and an external antenna connection. These are kinda on the expensive side at a few hundred dollars a piece but there pretty durable and u can usually get service for $50 a month. The catch is you'll usually have a data cap.

Otherwise, you can just have your local ISP drop you a line at the edge of your property and you run whatever power and network cable you need from there.

Yeah the point to point option would be my first choice. But if that's not possible, I would do 4g. Good brands for those types of routers are Sierra Wireless and Cradlepoint. I've had good experiences with those.

Ideally you adapt to coffee shops and public places. Download your porn and go home with it.

Life is much less easier to manage without the Internet in your actual home. Now if you have kids that need projects done routinely then it's a challenge because it's just easier to have it at home.
